'''S-Ipsus''' was a small sub-[[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], which orbited the floating city [[Ipsus]]. The sub-city was operated by the company [[Naescorcom/Legends|Naescorcom]] as a research station, and it contained a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] production line. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Believers]]&mdash;a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-worshipping [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]]&mdash;established a secret laboratory on S-Ipsus, in which they refined a [[Anti-Caarite virus|dangerous virus]] that they planned to use to wipe out the [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. However, the [[Metatheran Cartel]] learned of the existence of the Believer laboratory and a team of Cartel operatives subsequently traveled to S-Ipsus and assaulted the Believer facility.
